turnId.description: Identifier of the assistant turn that initiated the model call

model.description: Model identifier used for this API call, when known

previousResponseId.description: Previous response or interaction identifier included in the model request, when present

fusion.description: Experimental HydraFusion attribution for this concrete model call.

parentToolCallId.description: Parent task tool call ID when this model call belongs to a sub-agent

ModelCallStartData.description: Model API dispatch metadata for internal telemetry
ModelCallStartData.title: ModelCallStartData

hasUserSteering.description: Whether this model request consumed a user steering message rather than only internal Fusion work.

fusionId.description: Stable identifier for the HydraFusion turn that produced the event.

commitId.description: Idempotency identifier for the authoritative commit, when the event belongs to the selected output.

syntheticModel.description: Synthetic HydraFusion model selected for the session.

policy.description: HydraFusion routing policy used for the turn.

pattern.description: HydraFusion orchestration pattern selected for the turn.

phaseId.description: Identifier of the concrete phase that produced the event.

phaseKind.description: Kind of concrete phase that produced the event.

role.description: Semantic role assigned to the concrete phase.

sourceModel.description: Concrete model that produced the attributed event.

conversationScope.description: Conversation scope in which the concrete phase executed.

sourcePhaseId.description: Phase whose output supplied the authoritative content, when different from the executing phase.

FusionAttribution.description: Experimental attribution linking an ordinary event to the HydraFusion turn, phase, and concrete source that produced it.
FusionAttribution.title: FusionAttribution

turnId.description: Agent-loop iteration within the interaction that initiated the model dispatch

interactionId.description: Identifier of the user interaction that owns the model dispatch, matching assistant.turn_start.interactionId when available

dispatchDurationMs.description: Monotonic elapsed time spent in the logical model dispatch, including any internal transport reconnect or fallback and excluding orchestrator retry backoff, tool execution, confirmations, and post-response processing

outcome.description: Final outcome after post-response acceptance processing

containsBuiltInFileEditRequest.description: Whether an accepted successful response requested the exact name and command semantics of a built-in file edit tool, including an external tool explicitly replacing that built-in name. Absent when the logical dispatch did not produce an accepted response.

editClassifierVersion.description: Version of the built-in file-edit semantic classifier used for this event

ModelCallFinishedData.description: Final lifecycle outcome for one logical model dispatch. A logical dispatch may include internal reconnect or fallback work, so event count is not provider HTTP-request count.
ModelCallFinishedData.title: ModelCallFinishedData

ModelCallFinishedOutcome.description: Final outcome of one logical model dispatch after response acceptance processing
ModelCallFinishedOutcome.title: ModelCallFinishedOutcome

x-enumDescriptions.success: The provider response was accepted for continued agent processing.
x-enumDescriptions.error: The dispatch ended with a provider or transport error.
x-enumDescriptions.cancelled: The dispatch was cancelled before an accepted response was produced.
x-enumDescriptions.rejected: The provider response was rejected during post-response acceptance processing.

model.description: Model identifier used by the final attempt

isByok.description: Whether the final attempt used a bring-your-own-key provider

result.description: Bounded result of the final attempt

ModelCallFinalResultData.description: Internal telemetry result for one logical model operation after all orchestrator-owned retries settle
ModelCallFinalResultData.title: ModelCallFinalResultData

ModelCallFinalResult.description: Final bounded result of one logical model operation after its internal retry loop settles
ModelCallFinalResult.title: ModelCallFinalResult

x-enumDescriptions.http_400: The final attempt failed with HTTP 400.
x-enumDescriptions.http_413: The final attempt failed with HTTP 413.
x-enumDescriptions.http_429: The final attempt failed with HTTP 429.
x-enumDescriptions.http_4xx: The final attempt failed with another HTTP 4xx status.
x-enumDescriptions.http_5xx: The final attempt failed with an HTTP 5xx status.
x-enumDescriptions.transport_error: The final attempt failed in the request transport.
x-enumDescriptions.other_error: The final attempt failed without another bounded classification.
